name: Ruben Custom Sawmill and Woodworks, LLC
old_description: Founded by Matt Ruben in 2018, Ruben Custom Sawmill began with a single sawmill and a bold vision: reclaim Minnesota's fallen trees and turn them into lasting works of art. What started as a weekend passion is now a full-time, family-run business trusted by clients across the Twin Cities.
about:
Ruben Custom Sawmill and Woodworks, LLC operates from White Bear Township, Minnesota, in the Twin Cities metro area. The company was founded in 2018 by Matt Ruben, who began with a single portable sawmill and a vision to reclaim fallen Minnesota trees and transform them into lasting works of art. What started as a weekend passion has grown into a full-time, family-run business serving clients across the region.

The shop produces custom furniture including live-edge tables, bar tops, and mantles, as well as butcher-block-style walnut countertops. In addition to finished pieces, Ruben Custom Sawmill offers portable on-site milling services, bringing a Wood-Mizer sawmill directly to a client's property to process logs into kiln-dried slabs and native hardwood lumber available by appointment. The company reports having salvaged over 1,000 trees and completed projects for more than 1,000 clients.

Customers are primarily residential homeowners and DIY enthusiasts in the Twin Cities area who seek one-of-a-kind furniture or need logs milled from their own land. Testimonials reference projects such as a custom black walnut mantel fitted over an existing stone surround, a dining table built from a client's own cherry and burr oak logs, and a coffee table crafted from supplied slabs. The business also works with contractors and designers on custom countertop installations.

Ruben emphasizes care, craftsmanship, and character in every job, whether milling on a client's property or building a dining table in the shop. The founder's original mission — giving fallen trees a second life — remains the guiding principle, and the portable milling capability allows customers to preserve trees that hold personal significance.
